card: Adds test coverage targeting three surviving mutation testing bugs in assumeutxo and pruning validation logic. Existing tests did not catch regressions where ActivateBestChains mishandles validated chainstates or where GetPruneRange miscalculates snapshot block boundaries. The author cites surviving mutants 4388, 4385, and 4386 from MutantHub as justification.
evidence: Author cites three surviving mutants from MutantHub in validation.cpp: mutant 4388 (operator mutation in ActivateBestChains) and mutants 4385 and 4386 (off-by-one and arithmetic sign reversals in GetPruneRange).
problem: Validation logic regressions in assumeutxo activation and snapshot block pruning ranges went undetected by the test suite, allowing mutation bugs to survive in ChainstateManager::ActivateBestChains and Chainstate::GetPruneRange.

risk.why: Only modifies test assertions; a faulty test could cause false CI failures for developers.

scope_notes: The patch was omitted from the submission, but metadata shows a 5-line addition across two commits affecting a single test file.
summary: Adds test coverage to catch three mutation conditions in validation logic concerning assumeutxo and block pruning. Specifically, it adds assertions to detect when ActivateBestChains processes an already-validated chainstate and when GetPruneRange miscalculates boundary heights on unvalidated snapshot chains.
uncertainties: The actual diff and touched file list were not provided, leaving the exact test file (unit test vs functional test) and assertion implementations unconfirmed.
